name: switch-04
description: A controlled switch whose state is reflected in a live status line.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Label } from "@workspace/ui/components/label" import { Switch } from "@workspace/ui/components/switch" export default function ControlledSwitchStatus() { const [enabled, setEnabled] = React.useState(false) return (

{enabled ? "Designali is paused for new projects. Clients can browse but can't book." : "Designali is open and accepting new projects."}

) }
